title: Operador Multifuncional lll
description:
Job Description Summary

Executar atividades operacionais e técnicas nos processos de fabricação, montagem, manutenção e testes de componentes eletromecânicos, como estatores e rotores, em linhas seriadas, customizadas e de serviços. Operar equipamentos diversos (talhas, manipuladores, ponte rolante, máquinas CNC, prensas, entre outros), realizar acamação, isolamento, soldagem, testes elétricos e inspeções, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões de qualidade, segurança e produtividade estabelecidos. Contribuir para a organização da área produtiva, zelando pela conservação dos materiais e equipamentos, e apoiando na melhoria contínua dos processos industriais.

Job Description

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar movimentações de peças por meio de operação de talhas, manipuladores pneumáticos/hidráulicos e ponte rolante.
  • Separar kit e acessórios usados no enrolamento e acamação de estatores e rotores.
  • Na linha customizada realizar acamação Estatores e rotores MAC e LAC, Operar Maquina Bobina Formadora e Isoladora.
  • Na linha seriada realizar testes elétricos em processo, tais como: Hipot, Megger, Surge , Ponte kelvin, e outros. Realizar brasagem por maçarico e/ou indução e solda TIG.
  • Na linha de Serviços realizar as desmontagens, reparos e montagens mecânicas e elétricas de componentes de motores e geradores.
  • Na linha de serviços retirar bobina do estator conforme procedimento pré estabelecido.
  • Na linha de serviços preparar o processo de montagem, verificando lista de motor e analisando desenhos, instrução de processos e demais dados que possam ajudar no planejamento e organização das atividades.
  • Realizar a inspeção visual das peças a serem trabalhadas, verificando a existência de rebarbas e saliências de lâminas, bem como realizar o acabamento das mesmas, utilizando ferramenta adequada, quando necessário, ou acionando o controle de qualidade em situações de não conformidade.
  • Realizar o processo de acamação de bobinas em estatores e rotores MAC e LAC, controlando dimensões, altura da bobina na peça e entre ferro, baseado em instruções contidas em desenhos, diagramas, fichas de processo e procedimentos do sistema da qualidade.
  • Realizar o encaixe de melamina para calço de fundos de ranhura e entre as bobinas, a fim de efetuar a acomodação das mesmas na peça.
  • Realizar o isolamento dos anéis da peça, envolvendo-os com mica e cadarço de vidro.
  • Realizar a colocação de cunhas e feltros, após a acamação, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Na linha seriada realizar a ligação dos lides das bobinas acamadas, utilizando solda oxiacetilênica e oxigênio com eletrodo de prata, baseado no diagrama da peça.
  • Medir a resistência das bobinas, utilizando equipamento apropriado, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Na linha customizada realiza a fabricação de bobinas para motores de tração, conforme especificações de desenho, preparando e operando máquinas apropriadas, realizando os ajustes necessários à operação, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos, bem como efetuando inspeções de autocontrole.
  • Analisar ordens de produção, identificar e imprimir ou receber a lista de desenhos das bobinas a serem formadas e isoladas.
  • Preparam estatores MAC eLAC (exceto carcaça) para empilhamento, preparar estatores MAC eLAC para acabamento, sacar pino de estatoresMAC e LAC, medição dos diametro internos e externos dosestatores. Preparação e empilhamento de rotores MAC eLAC, inserção de barras, acabamento das ranhuras.
  • Analisar o desenho da bobina a ser formada, verificando as especificações quanto a graus, raios, passos, comprimento e outros detalhes.
  • Auxiliar na preparação e operar máquina CNC e/ou Manual, acionando comandos necessários à operação, bem como abastecendo a máquina e retirando as bobinas, manualmente, baseado em instruções contidas em ordens de produção, desenhos, fichas de processo e procedimentos do sistema da qualidade.
  • Auxiliar na medição das primeiras peças produzidas e durante o processo de produção, utilizando padrão apropriado (Damy), conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Auxiliar na preparação e operar máquina CNC, acionando comandos necessários à operação, bem como abastecendo a máquina e retirando as bobinas, manualmente, baseado em instruções contidas em ordens de produção, desenhos, fichas de processo e procedimentos do sistema da qualidade.
  • Medir as primeiras peças produzidas, utilizando equipamento apropriado, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Realizar teste elétrico nas peças produzidas, utilizando equipamento apropriado, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos, desde que treinado e habilitado.
  • Realizar a operação de equipamentos de pequenas, médias e grandes complexidade, convencionais (Prensas Ranhuradeiras de operação contínua e não-contínua), operar prensas blankadeiras afim de estampar blanks necessários conforme demanda, por meio de painéis de controle e/ou manualmente, alimentando as mesmas com matéria-prima, acompanhando a produção preestabelecida, bem como efetuar pequenas regulagens e/ou ajustagens nos equipamentos, baseado em instruções contidas em ordens de produção, desenhos, fichas de processo e procedimentosdo sistema da qualidade
  • Analisar o desgaste e solicitar a afiação de ferramentas dos equipamentos, sempre que necessário.
  • Operar e atuar no processo de Envernização/Secagem, de acordo com procedimentos preestabelecidos, sempre que necessário
  • Realizar a limpeza e organização da área produtiva
  • Anotar em relatório específico as informações referentes à produção.
  • Inspecionar as peças produzidas, visualmente e através de instrumentos de medição, a fim de conferir se as especificações do produto e padrões dequalidade estão de acordo com o preestabelecido.
  • Zelar pela ordem, guarda e conservação dos materiais, equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade e do local de trabalho, bem como manter a organização de toda a documentação referente ao processo do trabalho.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas a critério do seu superior imediato e/ou em relação aos procedimentos do seu processo de trabalho e/ou em relação aos procedimentos do sistema da qualidade.
  • EHS: Manter o compromisso primário com o Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (EHS), cumprindo com todos os requisitos legais e procedimentos internos aplicáveis ao seu local de trabalho. Engajar-se com a prevenção contra lesões, doenças e poluições relacionadas ao ambiente de trabalho, reportando imediatamente qualquer incidente, evento ou preocupação relacionada a EHS.
  • QUALIDADE : Manter o compromisso primário com o Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (QMS), cumprindo com todos os requisitos pertinentes a Certificação ISO 9001 através dos procedimentos internos aplicáveis ao seu local de trabalho. Engajar-se com a Política e Objetivos da Qualidade relacionadas as suas atividades, reportando imediatamente qualquer desvio frente a norma, regras, procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, evento ou preocupação relacionada a Qualidade.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência prévia em ambiente industrial.
  • Conhecimento básico em leitura de desenhos técnicos.
  • Noções de operação de máquinas e equipamentos industriais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em diferentes linhas de produção.
  • Comprometimento com segurança, qualidade e organização.

title: Mecânico I
description:
Job Description Summary
Executar atividades de montagem, desmontagem, ajustes e acabamento de motores e componentes mecânicos, garantindo a conformidade técnica dos processos e contribuindo para a qualidade e eficiência dos equipamentos produzidos ou reparados.

Job Description

  • Movimentar peças com talhas e ponte rolante, quando habilitado.
  • Preparar e auxiliar na montagem de partes mecânicas de máquinas, com base em desenhos e instruções técnicas.
  • Desmontar máquinas para orçamento, identificando desgastes e registrando o processo com fotos e planilhas.
  • Montar mancais (rolamentos e buchas), tubulações e componentes diversos conforme especificações.
  • Realizar ajustes de entreferro e centragem com instrumentos apropriados.
  • Executar empilhamento de estatores para geradores, incluindo alinhamento, prensagem, solda e acabamento.
  • Montar revestimentos acústicos em partes mecânicas, com corte, colagem e acabamento do material.
  • Analisar ordens de serviço e planejar a execução conforme sequência e recursos necessários.
  • Recuperar, substituir e montar peças e componentes mecânicos conforme instruções.
  • Remover e montar núcleos em carcaças, rotores e pólos, utilizando aquecimento ou força mecânica.
  • Montar e ajustar tubulações para circulação de óleo sob pressão.
  • Preparar dispositivos para ensaios de estanqueidade em serpentinas e radiadores.
  • Realizar acabamento final das peças montadas e auxiliar no nivelamento de bases e pedestais.
  • Executar montagem completa de motores e auxiliar na montagem de geradores de corrente alternada e contínua.
  • Inspecionar serviços realizados e registrar informações em relatórios específicos.
  • Fixar componentes de identificação, segurança e proteção nos motores.
  • Colaborar com programas de qualidade e melhoria contínua, seguindo normas de segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional.
  • Zelar pela organização e conservação dos materiais, equipamentos e documentação do processo.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato.
  • Ensino Médio concluído com curso Profissionalizante em Mecânica;
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos;
  • Normas de qualidade (relativas ao processo de atuação);
  • Normas de segurança;
  • Operação de Maçarico oxiacetilênico (para aplicação de calor na desmontagem de partes mecânicas);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no segundo turno (17h às 2h) em nossa fábrica em Campinas/SP.

  • Encantar os clientes no processo de vendas, atendendo e auxiliando sempre que necessário;
  • Atuar junto ao cliente no processo de finalização da compra;
  • Recebimento de valores, realizar a abertura e fechamento de caixa;

  • Assistência Médica de plano hospitalar com obstetrícia para todos os níveis hierárquicos e cobertura de todos os procedimentos no rol da ANS (Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar –

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About the Company


CHC Navigation is a global provider of innovative GNSS navigation and positioning solutions covering a wide range of professional applications, including land and airborne surveys, conventional GNSS surveys, 3D mass data acquisition, precision farming, unmanned navigation and robotics, real-time GNSS infrastructure, and more.


CHC Navigation is looking for a results-oriented Technical Support Engineer to join its LATAM team and take advantage of a significant growth opportunity in a rapidly expanding company. In this technical and hands-on role, you will ensure that our partners, resellers and clients are successfully trained in demonstrating, installing, and using our agriculture machinery. In addition, you will also be responsible for answering all technical questions and providing solutions in close communication with our worldwide Product Managers.


About the role


  • Ensure the successful onboarding of new partners from both a hardware and software perspective.
  • Provide timely technical support and training on product needs and issues via email, phone, web conference and in person.
  • Develop and manage the relationship with resellers and clients, being responsible for their product updates and technical requests.
  • Perform problem analysis to resolve product related issues including follow-up, testing, troubleshooting and identifying bugs and possible enhancements.
  • Support sales functions as a technical expert/consultant for precision agriculture .
  • Develop and update training materials.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Agricultural Engineering, Geomatics, Precision Agriculture, Agricultural Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of effective experience in customer service/technical support or technical training in agriculture machinery, positioning/navigation, LiDAR mapping, unmanned surveying, construction engineering, GIS, land surveying...
  • Fluency in Portuguese and professional level of English – written and oral – are mandatory.
  • Possess strong problem-solving skills and excellent analytical skills.
  • Presentation and public speaking skills, including training and technical demonstrations.
  • Comfort with learning new computer applications.


Note:
To be considered for this position, candidates must be Brazil citizens, and already living and eligible to work in Brazil.


Travel Requirements


There are some travels required in this role - including travel to a business partner or customer locations, trade shows, visit strategic accounts, other regional trips to support CHCNAV LATAM team.


What we offer


  • A job in an international result-oriented company where you can make full use of your skills.
  • Excellent business environment and career prospect in dynamic, high growth market.
  • The opportunity to develop yourself and be part of a fast-growing global company.
  • Remuneration commensurate with experience.

title: Lead Ai Success & Solutions
description:
About the Company RapidCanvas is the trusted partner for transforming your business with AI. We offer the only hybrid enterprise AI platform that combines autonomous agents with human experts to make enterprise-grade AI accessible to all organizations—without the massive investment or deep technical expertise it used to take. Our unique approach delivers measurable business outcomes 10X faster at 80% lower cost, helping global leaders in manufacturing, retail and consumer goods, financial services, and infrastructure turn what was once impossible into practical, everyday reality. About the Role RapidCanvas is hiring customer-facing specialists focusing on AI Success & Solutions to lead end-to-end delivery of bespoke AI projects—from initial solution design through full customer success ownership. This role merges the depth of a Solutions Architect with the accountability of a Customer Success leader. You will work across pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring our clients see real business value from our AI capabilities. The hiring seniority level will depend on the candidate’s depth of experience across customer-facing solution delivery, ability to drive measurable business impact, and demonstrated ownership in ambiguous or fast-paced environments. Responsibilities Pre-Sale:
Discovery & Solutioning Partner with Sales and Data Science to deeply understand the customer’s business context and challenges. Define clear problem statements, document current state processes, and align on success criteria and KPIs. Design solution architecture and data flow diagrams tailored to each use case. Assess data feasibility and AI-fit for the proposed use case. Set up technical and collaboration workspaces (Slack, Drive, JIRA, etc.) with naming and access discipline. Post-Sale:
Execution & Success Own the customer relationship post-sale, acting as the single point of accountability. Manage the execution and implementation of the solution, ensuring clarity of scope, timeline, and handoffs. Lead all internal and customer-facing check-ins, with clear agendas, follow-ups, and next-step ownership. Facilitate UAT and deployment, ensuring measurable outcomes are validated. Track and report on success metrics across 30/60/90-day milestones and ensure platform adoption. Operational Excellence Maintain rigorous documentation:
dataset inventories, architectural diagrams, solution design docs, etc. Ensure consistent file naming, visual branding, and version control across all customer-facing material. Keep Slack, HubSpot, JIRA, and Confluence spaces current and synchronized. Proactively escalate blockers, risks, or unclear ownership to leadership with proposed resolutions. Strategic Growth Identify expansion opportunities based on solution usage and customer success metrics. Collaborate with Product to feed back client needs and usage patterns into roadmap priorities. Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the client, helping them envision and prioritize future AI investments. Qualifications At least six (6) years in a hybrid technical+customer-facing role (Solutions Architect, Customer Success, Engagement Manager, etc.). Strong understanding of applied Data Science, ML, GenAI (e.G., LLM Prompting, RAG). Demonstrated success delivering AI or data-driven solutions in a consulting or startup setting. Excellent storytelling and business value articulation skills for both technical and executive audiences. Detail-oriented with exceptional project management and follow-through. Global client experience is strongly preferred. Prior experience in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with high expectations for ownership and delivery. Professional fluency in English is required. Why Join Us Drive measurable impact for Fortune 500 customers across the globe, helping them turn AI vision into operational value. Be part of a category-defining AI company, pioneering a hybrid model that bridges agents and experts. Own strategic accounts end-to-end and shape what modern AI success looks like. Work with a cross-functional, high-performance team that values execution, clarity, and outcomes. Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market. Recognized as a Top 5 Data Science and Machine Learning platform on G2 for customer satisfaction. Pay range and compensation package Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market. Equal Opportunity Statement RapidCanvas is committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: Sap Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US Syniti is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step;
enabling them to unlockvaluable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage.Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.As an innovative, global leader in Enterprise Data Management, the combination of our award-winning software platform and premier consultants creates a unique advantage for leading enterprises. Syniti is also a preferred data solution used by the world’s top system integrators. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.The ROLE We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.WHAT YOU WILL DO After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology. Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards. Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas. Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan. Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area. Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification. Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues. Create and maintain data load programs. Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO. Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations. Support and mentor junior colleagues.WHAT IT TAKES Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field). Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis. Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility. Functional ERP experience. Project experience across multiple ERP implementations. Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc. Customer facing skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.WHAT WE OFFER Autonomy and Trust:
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement. Growth Opportunities:
We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story. Collaborative Support:
We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors. Diversity of Stories:
Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story. Recognition:
We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member. Open Organization:
We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

Boa capacidade de redação jurídica e interpretação de normas aplicáveis ao setor financeiro e bancário;

Organização, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes;

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our Threat Research team. The primary responsibility of this role will be to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines for threat intelligence ingestion, validation, and export automation flows. Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines for ingesting threat intelligence data from various sources into our data ecosystem. Implement data validation processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Collaborate with threat analysts to understand data requirements and design appropriate solutions. Develop automation scripts and workflows for data export processes to external systems or partners. Optimize and enhance existing data pipelines for improved performance and scalability. Monitor data pipelines and troubleshoot issues as they arise, ensuring continuous data availability and integrity. Document technical specifications, data flows, and procedures for data pipeline maintenance and support. Stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering and incorporate them into our data ecosystem. Provide technical guidance and support to other team members on data engineering best practices and methodologies. Requirements:
Proven experience as a Data Engineer or similar role, with a focus on data ingest, validation, and export automation. Strong proficiency in Python. Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, or similar. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Experience with data validation techniques and tools for ensuring data quality. Experience building and deploying images using containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Manual QA Specialist who loves uncovering issues beyond the typical user journey and strengthening the quality of complex B2B SaaS applications. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on exploring edge cases, validating intricate workflows, and ensuring a robust, enterprise-ready product. Key Responsibilities:
✔️ Execute comprehensive manual testing of B2B SaaS web applications (multi-user workflows, account management, role-based access, data-heavy interfaces). ✔️ Design and run test cases for edge cases, boundary conditions, and unexpected user behavior to uncover hidden defects. ✔️ Develop detailed test plans and cases for new features, regression testing, and consistent system behavior. ✔️ Collaborate with Product, Development, and UX teams to align feature expectations and risk areas. ✔️ Log and manage bugs using tools like JIRA, with clear documentation and severity assessment. ✔️ Validate API integrations and backend processes using tools like Postman, ensuring data consistency and accurate business logic. ✔️ Support automation efforts (e.G., basic UI regression with Selenium, Postman scripts for API checks). ✔️ Conduct exploratory testing and lightweight performance/stress tests to ensure resilience. ✔️ Ensure cross-browser, responsive, and compatibility testing across enterprise environments. Skills & Qualifications:
✅ 3+ years of manual QA experience testing SaaS or enterprise-grade web apps. ✅ Strong ability to design tests that go beyond the "happy path" and anticipate real-world issues. ✅ Hands-on experience with exploratory testing, boundary testing, fuzz testing, and performance edge cases. ✅ Proficiency with issue tracking and test management tools (e.G., JIRA, TestRail). ✅ Working knowledge of Postman for API testing and basic QA automation concepts. ✅ Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and clear documentation abilities. ✅ Comfortable working in agile, iterative development environments. Ideal Candidate:
You love breaking things—constructively. You’re not satisfied with surface-level testing and excel at finding hidden defects that others overlook. You bring structure to QA processes and care deeply about delivering reliable, high-performance enterprise software.

requisitos e qualificações;

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Full-Time/Remote)
description:
Smile is a national digital health company with almost 20 years in the industry, comprising 5 divisions including the National Dental Network, Health Fund Partnerships, Projects & Investments plus more recently, Retail Dental Cover and Corporate Dental Cover. Smile is committed to revolutionising quality healthcare accessibility and affordability for the people of Australia. Smile is the top-rated dental cover in the country, offering Retail Dental Cover to the public and Corporate Dental Cover to companies and their teams across Australia. Smile has been operating successfully with a globally distributed team since 2017. The Role ROLE OBJECTIVES This performance profile seeks to attract a performance marketer with a proven track record of driving business growth using paid tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, TikTok, and other paid marketing platforms. As a performance marketer, you will be accountable for driving revenue and sales for Retail Dental Cover and Corporate Dental Cover. This role will be reporting to the Head of Marketing and will be a part of the Retail Dental Cover & Corporate Dental Cover Divisions. The position will have a full-time commitment of 40 hours per week with at least 6 hours of crossover b/w 8 am-5 pm GMT+10 (Brisbane, Australia) Key Responsibilities Strategic Campaign Development Develop and execute paid search strategies aligned with business goals to increase member acquisition for our dental cover products across Google, Bing and other relevant search platforms. Develop and execute paid social campaigns to acquire new members and retain existing ones. Develop platform-specific ad creatives (videos and static) along with a detailed plan to drive revenue and sales across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant channels. Campaign Optimisation Continuously monitor, analyse, and optimise PPC campaigns to maximise ROI, improve click-through rates, and reduce cost per acquisition across platforms. This includes optimising targeting options, ad placements, and bidding strategies. Collaborate with the sales team to align messaging and drive enterprise-level growth. Conduct thorough keyword research to identify relevant search terms and opportunities. Manage keyword bids, ad copy, and landing page optimisation to enhance campaign performance across all advertising channels. Monitor, develop and analyse paid social campaigns to maximise ROI and reduce cost per acquisition across platforms. This includes optimising the target audience, ad creative and landing pages. Own the Complete Funnel Develop ideas for generating leads and revenue through targeted Top, Middle & Bottom of the funnel campaigns. Maintain a 360° view of the funnel, tracking everything from impressions to conversions on a daily basis. Identify opportunities and troubleshoot issues at both the campaign and website levels to optimise performance. Monitor key metrics and report insights regularly to drive timely improvements. Work closely with stakeholders (design, content, and IT) to address and resolve the funnel-related concerns. Budget Management Effectively manage PPC and paid social budgets to ensure optimal allocation of funds across campaigns and channels, maintaining a balance between cost efficiency and performance. Testing Develop testing hypotheses and implement a prioritised testing plan to ensure continuous learning. Coordinate A/B testing of ad copy, creative and bidding strategies to identify high-performing variations and improve overall campaign and company search performance. Performance Reporting Generate regular reports on key PPC metrics, including impressions, clicks, conversions, and cost per conversion across all advertising platforms. Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive continuous improvement in campaign performance. Generate regular reports on key paid social campaign metrics. Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive continuous improvement in campaign performance. Hunt for New Platforms Explore new opportunities across paid platforms and channels to sustain and accelerate growth. Drive revenue with a growth mindset - through structured experimentation programs, learn from failures and make data-driven decisions. Collaboration & Communication Collaborate with the designer & content manager to ensure creatives and communication are in line with brand guidelines. Work closely with the SEO lead and the rest of the Growth Marketing team to align performance marketing strategies with organic search initiatives and overall marketing programs. Communicate campaign performance, updates, and insights effectively to stakeholders. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Acquisition (Grow Smile™dental cover) Drive month-on-month growth in dental cover sales by building and executing a scalable acquisition plan for Smile™. Stay forward-looking, adapt confidently in ambiguity, and operate with a strong growth mindset to consistently achieve targets. ROI (Return on Investment) Measure the sales and revenue generated from individual platforms and campaigns. Track, monitor and improve the Lifetime Value of the customer, ensuring positive ROI for each campaign. CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) Monitor and optimise the average cost incurred to acquire a new member or lead through campaigns, maximising new member acquisition within budget parameters. Monitor and implement strategies to improve metrics across each stage of the acquisition funnel. Ideal Profile Requirements This FULL-TIME ROLE will only suit someone who also meets the following requirements:
Has a passion for excelling in all they do, and this is evidenced in the extra references provided in your application. Has extensive experience and evidence of achieving exceptional results with paid platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid social platforms. Demonstrated success running successful Google ads and Meta ads is a must. Should be analytical, strategic, and creative when the role requires it. A growth mindset is essential - someone who embraces challenge, learns from feedback, and continuously seeks improvement. Has perfectly spoken & written English. Has the highest integrity. If you believe you are a great fit for the role and meet ALL requirements above, we are looking forward to hearing from you! What's on Offer? 100% Remote:
Enjoy the flexibility and convenience of working from anywhere. Full-Time Position:
Secure a stable and consistent work schedule. Similar Time Zone:
Work seamlessly with a team in a compatible time zone. Established Company:
Join a nearly 20-year-old successful & growing organisation. National Presence:
Be part of a national Australian company. Meaningful Work:
Contribute to a noble mission to revolutionise quality healthcare accessibility and affordability. Top-Tier Leadership & Team:
Collaborate with 'A' leadership and 'A' players, including a successful Australian/Canadian Founder & CEO and a successful Silicon Valley CMO and a successful Head of Marketing from India. Excellent Culture:
Thrive in a positive and supportive work environment with a long-serving team. Integrated Marketing Strategy:
A company with a cohesive marketing strategy ensures that PPC and paid social campaigns align with broader marketing goals, improving overall campaign effectiveness and brand consistency.

Efetuar a entregamensaldas obrigações acessórias no âmbito Federal considerando os tributos indiretos, como EFD/Contribuições, DCTF, Per/Dcomp, EFD/Reinf;
Manter-se atualizado(a)das legislações municipal, estadual e federal, garantindo seu cumprimento;

Optimizing build processes to improve application performance and loading times. Proficient in REST API integration, including security and authentication strategies. Hands-on experience developing browser extensions, extending automation beyond traditional web applications. Bonus:
Experience with WebSockets for real-time data updates and event-driven UI interactions. Bonus:
Full-stack experience with backend technologies like Node.Js and Nest.Js. What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment. Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Why join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

Next Degree Products is a leading e-commerce company headquartered in the United States. We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Channel Growth Manager to accelerate the growth and engagement of our digital channels. Develop and implement comprehensive growth strategies to boost channel performance and audience engagement. Analyze performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Manage and optimize paid and organic campaigns across various channels (e.G., YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, email marketing). Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform strategic planning and decision-making. Prepare and present detailed reports on channel performance, insights, and recommended actions. Qualifications:
3+ years of experience in digital marketing, channel management, or growth marketing roles. Proven track record of driving significant growth and engagement on digital channels. Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in using analytics tools (Google Analytics, social media insights, etc.). Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Self-motivated, proactive, and innovative mindset. What Success Looks Like:
Increased engagement metrics and significant audience growth across targeted channels. Consistent achievement of defined performance and growth targets. Effective collaboration across teams, contributing to cohesive and aligned strategic initiatives. Data-driven insights clearly informing strategic decisions and resulting in measurable improvements. Demonstrable improvements in campaign ROI and cost-efficiency. Benefits Competitive salary of $1,800 to $2,800 USD per month, based on experience. Remote-work flexibility with opportunities for collaboration at Next Degree Products’ office, if desired. Engaging and innovative work environment with a passionate team. Opportunity for professional growth and skill development. Employee discounts on Next Degree Products. Why Join Us? Opportunity to play a key role in a data-driven e-commerce company. Collaborative and supportive team culture. Opportunities for growth and skill development. Competitive salary and flexible work environment. Application Process Join us at Next Degree Products, a fast-growing private-label e-commerce brand, and be part of our mission to deliver innovative, high-quality products that enhance everyday life. Please fill out this form to be considered for the job. We look forward to hearing from you!

Na Bionovis, trabalhamos com o propósito de ampliar o acesso da população brasileira a medicamentos inovadores, seguindo sempre os mais rigorosos padrões científicos, técnicos e éticos. "Somos uma comunidade voltada para um propósito, não apenas uma empresa." Serão desafios desse profissional:
Realizar as atividades laboratoriais, relacionadas aos projetos de novos produtos, garantindo o cumprimento dos cronogramas estabelecidos, assim como as atividades analíticas de desenvolvimento, transferência e validação de metodologias executadas dentro das boas práticas de laboratório. Para concorrer a vaga, você deve ter:
Domínio de técnicas instrumentais Bioanalíticas como PcR, ELISA, Bioensaios etc Expertise em normas regulatórias e guias internacionais (ICH Q2(R1), USP, Ph. Eur., ANVISA). Familiaridade com ferramentas de qualidade (FMEA, CAPA) e softwares analíticos especializados. Domínio nos processos de investigação laboratorial para resultados não conforme utilizando técnicas e ferramentas de investigação de desvio (Ex. 6Ms, Ishikawa) Conhecimento no sistema de gerenciamento de laboratório (LIMS), preferencialmente no SampleManager da Thermo. Conhecimento no sistema de gestão de documentos Se Suite. Conhecimento do pacote office com ênfase em Excel Conhecimento sistema integrado (Ex. SAP) Noções em processo farmacêutico biológico. Ensino superior completo em Farmácia, Química, Biologia, Biotecnologia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas será considerado um diferencial. Desconto em conta de energia elétrica (CPFL Paulista, Cemig e Light) Programa de Apoio à Saúde Física e Emocional (PAE e Avatar da Saúde) Licença paternidade e Maternidade estendidas. PLR conforme metas. Cartão cesta de Natal. Horário de trabalho:

de Segunda a sexta-feira de 14h30m até 23h15m Na Bionovis somos diversos e valorizamos o respeito e a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades, que fazem cada pessoa única, incluindo:

These include B2Core (CRM and back office for brokers), B2Trader (digital asset matching engine), and B2CONNECT—a crypto-native liquidity aggregation and distribution platform that offers access to multi-asset liquidity, synthetic instruments, advanced execution strategies, and institutional-grade connectivity.For more information about our solutions, visit b2broker.Com.Job Specification:

Stay ahead of market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes in the FX industry.Provide actionable insights to the management team to refine sales strategies and product offerings.Identify and exploit new market opportunities to maintain a competitive edge.Reporting and Performance Tracking:
Maintain detailed records of sales activities, prospects, and deal progress using CRM tools.Prepare regular reports on sales performance, pipeline status, and market feedback.Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales quotas.QualificationsMandatory Experience:
Minimum of 5 years of direct sales experience in the FX industry, specifically selling liquidity solutions to institutional clientsDemonstrated success in closing large-scale deals and consistently exceeding sales targetsExtensive experience in generating cold leads and converting them into long-term clientsIndustry Expertise:
Deep understanding of FX liquidity provision, trading platforms, and market dynamicsStrong existing network of institutional clients, including banks, hedge funds, and proprietary trading firmsProven ability to work with Introducing Brokers and expand professional networks effectivelySkills and Competencies:

Remote Position Overview Are You a Performance-Driven Strategist Who Knows How to Make Google & YouTube Ads Scale? If you thrive on performance data, love solving ROAS puzzles, and know how to build and scale high-converting campaigns on Google and YouTube, this could be your next big move. We’re looking for a strategic thinker who can own and scale a multi-million-dollar search engine account. You’ll be responsible for campaign strategy, performance optimization, and growing Google ad spend into the multi-millions, while launching YouTube as a standalone acquisition channel. This isn’t a plug-and-play role. We want someone who owns results, makes decisive moves, and isn’t afraid to be accountable for outcomes. If you need step-by-step direction or shy away from taking full responsibility, this isn’t the role for you. Responsibilities Budget Management & Channel Scaling Manage and optimize a $600K/month Google Ads engine, with ~$500K allocated to Search and Performance Max. Take ownership of scaling Google ad spend from six figures to multi-millions while maintaining strong performance metrics. Build and grow YouTube as its own high-performing acquisition channel, developing a strategy tailored to its unique strengths. Ensure efficient budget allocation across campaigns, balancing aggressive growth with disciplined ROI targets. Forecast performance, scale winners, and pull back on underperformers with confidence and speed. Campaign Strategy & Execution Own the full lifecycle of Google and YouTube ad campaigns—from planning and launch to optimization and scaling. Execute both search and video strategies using Google Ads and YouTube Ads Manager. Set up advanced audience targeting, keyword strategies, bidding models, and exclusions. Build and manage campaigns across multiple products and funnels, ensuring high efficiency and profitability. Performance Optimization Analyze campaign data daily to identify trends, diagnose performance issues, and uncover opportunities. Optimize key metrics including CTR, CPC, ROAS, conversion rate, and CPA. Rapidly test and iterate on creatives, headlines, calls to action, and landing page combinations. Collaborate with our creative team to brief and test new video and static assets. Creative & Funnel Collaboration Partner with the creative team to ensure video scripts and visuals are optimized for YouTube’s first 5 seconds and beyond. Provide feedback on hooks, visual pacing, and CTA integration based on performance data. Align paid traffic with appropriate landing pages, upsells, and conversion paths. Industry Knowledge Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and new ad formats for Google and YouTube. Bring new strategies, trends, and tactics to the table that keep us ahead of the competition. Requirements 5+ years running paid Google and/or YouTube campaigns Proven experience managing a minimum of $1 million dollars of ad spend in Google and YouTube Proven experience growing ad spend Proven track record of scaling performance with ROAS and CAC accountability Deep understanding of Google Ads platform, YouTube Ads, and audience segmentation Strong data literacy and ability to interpret performance metrics to drive decision-making Experience with attribution models and tracking setups (GA4, UTMs, etc.) Comfortable writing or editing ad copy for performance, not just branding Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment Experience using tools like Google Ads Editor, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, etc. Familiarity with AI tools to streamline analysis or creative ideation is a plus Additional requirements:
Willingness to work US time zones, regardless of geographic location. Access to a computer Reliable internet connection Reliable and distraction-free work environment Must be fluent in English (read/write/speak) Offer Details This is a full-time, remote contractor role that is open to international candidates. Pay is competitive and based on experience, skill level, and geographic location.

Fundada em 2017 por profissionais do mercado financeiro, a Hurst se dedica a criar tecnologia para originar, estruturar e distribuir ativos alternativos, como precatórios, recebíveis, imóveis, royalties de música, cinema e obras de arte. Estamos em constante crescimento e expansão de operações, enfrentando grandes desafios que exigem pessoas dedicadas e ambiciosas. Buscamos profissionais que desejem fazer parte dessa jornada e crescer conosco. DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:
Estamos em busca de um talento para o cargo de Desenvolvedor(a) Backend, para atuar em nosso time de TI. REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS:
Experiência demonstrada em Node.Js, preferencialmente com TypeScript, para desenvolvimento de aplicações robustas e eficientes;
Profundo conhecimento de arquitetura Orientada a Eventos, sendo capaz de construir e manter sistemas reativos;
Proficiência em testesde software, incluindo testes de unidade, integração e ponta a ponta (E2E), para garantir a qualidade do código e a confiabilidade do software, infraestruturas em nuvem, particularmente AWS, incluindo a implantação e manutenção de aplicações e serviços. RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:
Experiência em implementação de infraestrutura como código (IaC) e integração contínua / entrega contínua (CI/CD), por exemplo, através do uso de GitHub Actions, Conhecimento em bancos de dados não relacionais para armazenamento e manipulação eficaz de dados;
Compreensão eexperiência com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, para gerenciamento eficaz de projetos, Experiência com linguagens fortemente tipadas, como Java e Go. CONSIDERADO DIFERENCIAIS:
Experiência no design e implementação de arquiteturas baseadas em microservices, Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações, incluindo a prevenção de ataques comuns e a proteção de dados sensíveis;
Familiaridadecom ferramentas de conteinerização como Docker e orquestradores como Kubernetes, Experiência com o design de APIs RESTful ou GraphQL;
Capacidade deidentificar gargalos de desempenho e otimizar código para velocidade e eficiência. Gostou? Então vem com a gente, se você é uma pessoa que:
É comunicativo;
Aceita bem feedbacks;
Esta dispostoa crescer e vestir a camisa da empresa;
Comprometido;
Está diposto a aprender novas ferramentas caso necessário;
Proativo. Amamos o que fazemos e o nosso é GIGANTE e, por isso, temos uma rotina intensa em busca da construção desse sonho. O que é importante saber sobre o nosso jeito de trabalhar? Nosso compromisso é com o aprendizado e evolução constante, temos a humildade de saber que há muito para aprender e estamos dispostos a investir energia em busca da excelência. Com alma empreendedora, todos têm muita autonomia para trazer soluções e novas ideias e cada um é protagonista da sua história. Temos grandes objetivos e precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a criar os caminhos necessários para atingi-los. INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:
Oferecemos os seguintes benefícios:

Capacidade de preenchimento de relatórios e planilhas. Por que Unox? Inovação contínua :

Fomos certificados pelo Great Place To Work Institute como uma das 100 melhores empresas da Europa. Nosso ambiente de trabalho jovem e positivo promove a colaboração e valoriza as ideias de todos os nossos funcionários. Organizamos regularmente eventos da empresa para networking e formação de equipes com colegas. Crescimento Profissional :
A Unox investe no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores por meio de programas de treinamento contínuo, coaching individual e oportunidades de carreira, garantindo constante crescimento pessoal e profissional. title: Business Technical Services Analyst
description:
TSYS, a Global Payments company, is the payment stack for the future and operating in more than 75 countries around the world, we process billions of card transactions each year. As part of our growth as a card processor, we are looking for a Business Technical Service Analyst, with relevant experience in client facing roles and PL/SQL, to be part of our team. If you are looking for professional development and would like to be part of our amazing growth in Latin America & The Caribbean, apply today and join our award-winning Fortune 500® company! If you want more reasons for choosing us, we can help you:
Flexibility to work from home People centered environment Contact with teams from different countries Attractive policy of salary and benefits What Part Will You Play? Gains and maintains knowledge of how to identify critical business impact issues from Service Desk. Assists with documents and maintenance to the clients' system environments by keeping records of client functionality, environment, and client specific documentation while providing to more senior levels for review and feedback. Participates in release management between Service Desk, Compliance and Project as well as client activities such as Payment Card Industry audits and internal projects, ensuring that code release doesn't negatively impact client operations. Takes part in execution of simple project/development work plans and learns to revise them as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements. Minimum Qualifications Relevant Experience or Degree in:
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field. Solid experience in Oracle Database and PL/SQL development;
Previous experience consulting with clients to meet business needs. Experience in requirements gathering, technical design and technical presentation. Advanced English level for speaking, listening and writing. At TSYS we recognize that innovation and transformation only happen in inclusive and safe work environment and as an equal opportunity employer, we strongly encourage people with disabilities to apply to any of our job positions.

description:

Your work helps fine-tune how language models respond to real-world queries, from search engine results to ad relevance and semantic comprehension. Every decision you make will directly contribute to building smarter, more human-like AI. This is a remote, full-time position requiring fluency in both Dutch and English (minimum B2 level).Main Responsibilities:
In this role, you will assess relationships between user queries and advertiser keywords, determine semantic containment, and ensure ratings align with defined guidelines. Your work will directly contribute to improving large language models (LLMs) and machine learning systems. Analyze query–keyword pairs to determine if the user query is semantically contained in the advertiser keyword using specific guidelines Label data accurately within the client’s rating platform, contributing to the development of AI systems for natural language understanding and ad relevance. Perform related tasks such as search engine results page (SERP) analysis, user intent assessment, and side search relevance checks. Apply critical thinking and semantic reasoning to detect meaning shifts, intent differences, and subtle variations in language use. Follow strict quality and productivity targets while working independently in a remote setting. Stay aligned with evolving language trends and maintain objectivity by avoiding personal bias in assessments.Key Skills & Competencies:
Analytical thinking with a high level of semantic and pattern recognition. Proficiency in online research and information validation. Strong communication skills and written comprehension. Bias awareness and ability to apply objective judgment based on defined criteria. Self-motivation, focus, and reliability in remote work environments.Required Knowledge:

Habilidades de liderança e boa comunicação;
Capacidade de motivar, orientar equipe e integrar áreas.O Grupo Onet é uma referência global nas áreas de facilities, engenharia e segurança, com um compromisso sólido com a responsabilidade social e a capacitação profissional contínua. title: Consultor De Treinamento
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:
2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país. Como nosso Consultor de Treinamentos, você irá:
Desenvolver, ministrar e acompanhar treinamentos técnicos sobre sistemas elétricos, hidráulicos e mecânicos de equipamentos da linha amarela para a frota SANY;
Elaborar material didático para suporte aos treinamentos;
Possuir conhecimento sobre frotas de linha amarela de médio e grande porte;
Entender o funcionamento dos sistemas hidráulico, elétrico, mecânico e do trem de força em equipamentos móveis;
Realizar análises de perfis de perdas e desenvolver procedimentos de melhoria para garantir a confiabilidade;
Monitorar a efetividade das práticas de manutenção e conduzir reciclagens de procedimentos técnicos;
Auxiliar na implementação de novas tecnologias e práticas nos equipamentos SANY;
Fazer interface entre operação e manutenção, avaliando as interferências do modo de operação na disponibilidade física dos equipamentos;
Participar dotratamento de incidentes, incluindo falhas operacionais e acidentes;
Identificar riscos relacionados à execução de atividades e propor medidas de controle adequadas;
Avaliar a segurança demanutenção, diagnóstico e reformas, identificando mudanças necessárias e propondo soluções cabíveis. Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:
Superior Completo em Engenharia (Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção, Eletromecânica e Mineração);
Conhecimentointermediário no Microsoft Office;
Conhecimento em manutenção e diagnostico em equipamentos de linha amarela;
Experiência da aplicação de treinamentos teóricos e práticos;
Experiência anterior em instrução de equipamentos em mineração;
Possuir disponibilidade de viagens. Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:
Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale Refeição Transporte Crédito Consignado Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Lead Software Developer In Test
description:
Lead SDET Position Summary:
Our partner is a rapidly growing SaaS company providing intuitive remote monitoring and endpoint management solutions for IT teams. Currently, they are seeking a talented and driven QA Engineer with strong expertise in both manual and automated testing. The QA Engineer will be instrumental in guiding manual QA engineers, identifying and prioritizing test cases for automation, and ensuring the quality and efficiency of software testing processes. In this key role, you’ll lead manual QA efforts and collaborate closely with development and product teams to uphold the reliability, accuracy, and performance of the platform driving continuous improvements in testing strategy, coverage, and execution. Experience and Education:
B.S. or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical field/experience 5+ years of experience in software testing, with expertise in creating test plans, test cases, and test strategies for both manual and automated testing Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to write and debug code especially in React/Node environments. Experience working with reporting teams and large datasets, ensuring data accuracy and validating end-to-end data flows Strong analytical skills and a detail-oriented mindset, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and drive testing improvements Skills and Strengths:
Manual Testing, including testing of web applications, system-level applications, and other software types. Automation Testing, covering web applications, system-level applications, and additional software components. JavaScript Functional Testing Non-Functional Testing Blackbox Testing Whitebox Testing Smoke Testing TestRail TestCafe TDD (Test Driven Development) Writing Test Cases Executing Test Plans Bug Reporting in JIRA SQL Queries PostgreSQL Primary Job Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on software requirements and specifications. Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing on web and mobile applications. Identify, document, and track software defects using defect management tools. Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to understand product requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage. Participate in test plan and requirement reviews, providing actionable feedback on features and quality aspects. Develop and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as TestCafe, Selenium, JUnit, or similar frameworks. Execute automated test suites, analyze test results, and investigate issues to support rapid defect resolution. Coordinate with the automation team to seamlessly integrate manual and automated testing efforts. Ensure all testing activities align with the overall testing strategy, quality standards, and company guidelines. Continuously improve the QA process by developing and implementing best practices for both manual and automated testing. Provide regular status reports on test progress, defect status, and key quality metrics to the QA Manager and other stakeholders.

title: Senior Ux/Ui Designer
description:
Formify:
where imagination becomes live and interactive! We're on a mission to revolutionize the world of 3D visualization software with our cutting-edge, web-based platform that brings products, cabinetry, and customized apartments to life in real-time. At Formify, we're not just creating a SaaS product, we are optimizing the users experience by redefining how people experience and interact with 3D visualizations. Our live rendering technology takes you on a journey into a world where creativity knows no bounds. Whether you're a seasoned designer, a tech enthusiast, or someone who simply appreciates the beauty of customization, we have a place for you on our team. We are currently hiring a Senior UX / UI Designer to join our exciting start-up team on an initial 12 month Fixed Term Contract. Responsibilities:
Conduct comprehensive user research to understand target audiences and their needs Create wireframes and prototypes to visualize and communicate design concepts Design visually appealing and responsive user interfaces Iterate designs based on user feedback and usability testing results Document design decisions, rationale, and guidelines for reference and collaboration Requirements:
At least five years of experience as a UI/UX designer Experienced in making designs for the web Experience with Figma Experience with Jira would be an advantage Working closely with development teams Experience applying UI/UX Design in an agile process The successful candidate will… Have a passion for creativity in their work Take on a proactive, hands-on approach Have a proven track-record of working closely with developers to come up with a pixel perfect solution Why join us at Formify? Innovation at its Core:
We're not following trends;
we're setting them. Ourteam is driven by an insatiable curiosity and a passion for pushing the boundaries of what's possible in 3D visualization. Endless Creative Opportunities :
Imagine being part of a company where your work allows users to create, customize, and visualize their dream apartments, furniture, and more in real-time. Your contribution will be at the forefront of making dreams a reality. Collaboration and Growth :
We foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. You'll work with a talented team of like-minded professionals who are committed to pushing the limits of technology:
interacting daily with C level executives. Impact :
Your work will have a real-world impact on industries like interior design, architecture, and e-commerce. You'll be contributing to the tools that help our clients bring their ideas to life. Continuous Learning :
In a fast-paced, ever-evolving industry, we believe in continuous learning and development. You'll have access to resources and opportunities to keep your skills sharp and your knowledge up-to-date. Flexibility :
We understand that life is not just about work. We offer flexible working arrangements. If you're a visionary, a dreamer, a creative thinker, or a tech wizard with a passion for transforming the way people visualize and create, we want you on our team. Join us at Formify and let's shape the future of 3D visualization together. Your journey starts here. Formify is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive working environment. We encourage all interested applicants to reach out, regardless of whether their experience matches perfectly, their background, and other factors protected by law.

title: Talent Acquisition
description:
At Blueground, our vision is to make people feel at home wherever they choose to live. For us, that means ensuring our guests have the peace of mind, flexibility & confidence they need to explore life’s latest adventure.We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team and help us attract and develop top talent across USA. You will focus on bringing on-board amazing people that will love our culture and embrace our values. If you are a target-driven professional, who has a passion for attracting great talent and creating an exceptional candidate experience, this is an opportunity to drive your career forward! As a Blueground talent scout, you will manage the recruitment process from end to end and collaborate with our leadership team to bring on board amazing people.What you will focus on:
Sourcing - be an expert in sourcing hard-to-fill positions and finding the best talent in PropTech through using innovative sourcing methods including utilizing an agile sourcing methodology across USAProactive Talent Pooling - build diverse talent pools through effective targeting and talent pipelining of both passive and active candidates. You will be responsible for actively overseeing regular and accurate updates of our global job adverts, external jobs boards, recruitment networking and the promotion of our refer a friend scheme;
keeping D&I in mind through every part of the Talent Attraction process.Be a Blueground Ambassador - Get people excited about Blueground and match great talent to great opportunities. You will often be the first person that someone talks to from Blueground, so you need to be great at understanding what motivates them and match their motivations with the many benefits of working here.Collaborative Hiring Process - Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and relevant stakeholders, ensuring a seamless interview process for candidates. Facilitate candidate feedback sessions and debrief meetings to gather input and make informed hiring decisions. Work closely with HR teams to manage offer negotiations, pre-employment checks, and onboarding processes.Candidate Relationship Management - Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely communication and guidance. Ensure a positive candidate experience by delivering clear and transparent communication, managing expectations, and providing feedback. Build and maintain relationships with candidates to create a pipeline of talent for current and future hiring needs.What we are looking for:
2+ years of experience with hiring process;
Knowledge and experience of online sourcing including social/professional networking (e.G. LinkedIn Recruiter).Candidate experience focused, passionate about employer branding and being creative in our approach to sourcing talent.Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, tenacious, personable and articulate.Advanced EnglishAbility to establish trusted relationships with management, candidates and external partners.Positive attitude combined with a desire to make work fun.A team player that will fit with our values and add to our culture.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Node.Js - Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node - Sênior. Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais.Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente! Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.Js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados. Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus. Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas Requisitos:
Experiência sólida com Node.Js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD). Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate). Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências. Testes Automatizados:
domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes. Escalabilidade e Desempenho:
experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).Performance e Debugging:
uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.Js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.Integração Contínua e Deploy:
prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.Docker Avançado:
criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado:
MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).APIs Performáticas e Seguras:
experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.Git Profundo:
workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes. Diferenciais:
Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony):
será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.Experiência com React (ou Next.Js):
habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).Frameworks Node.Js avançados:

aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. ***Quem Somos A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. ***O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Senior Full-Stack Web Software Engineer (Remote)
description:
Unilingo connects a single video to every audience, in every language, on every major platform — with no extra work. This is not some ‘one-click’ marketing fluff. With Unilingo, one upload is all it takes. We pioneered multi-language content for YouTube, putting MrBeast and other top creators into 10+ languages. Since then, we've given creators 100 billion views, $50 million in AdSense revenue, and global recognition. With 48,000+ global submissions in the pipeline, we're only getting started. We’re building the command center for digital content — a syndication network that publishes from a single upload to any platform, in any format, in any language. What you build here will be seen in every country on Earth. Please email your resume to:
The Role We’re a growing team of self-motivated engineers. We put in long hours not because we have to but because we care about the impact we’re generating. We hope to do more in a week than most other teams do in a month. We are looking for a full-stack engineer who’s excited to experience the adventure of being in an early stage startup. We hope for your time here to be the most rewarding in your career. You’ll be given a lot of responsibility and the freedom to solve problems. Responsibilities Own the problem and work with the engineers and designer to generate a solution Build, test, and ship features that solves user problems Look at data and talk to users to get feedback about the feature Triage and fix bugs Generate proposals (through meetings, docs, and Figma) to help align team on your solution if it’s a multi-person effort Review PRs to ensure that you’re not siloed in your own feature and that standards are upheld Requirements 5+ years of experience with Node, React, and Typescript You’re not afraid to touch all parts of code when needed — from mouse click to DB. If you specialize in back-end, you should at least be able to disable a button on the front-end. If you’re front-end, you should at least be able to cast a return type of an endpoint field from a string to an int Deploy your own code. We don’t have an ops team here, so you get to own deployment as well Excellent written skills (in English) B2 or above spoken English proficiency Bonus Previous startup experience — having started your own or joined one before Python and some experience with implementing or deploying ML models Speaks a language other than English (and code) Cloud functions, NoSQL DB Why Work With Us You’ll hopefully experience the highest growth rate of your career here. You’ll be given freedom to execute. You and the rest of the team will likely make mistakes, but that’s okay because it’s a signal that we’re going to the edge of our capabilities - which means growth. We believe that this is what a startup is all about. You will be working closely with Jon, our CTO, and Farbod, our CEO. Jon is an ex-Meta engineer and a top creator himself in his past life with 20M+ views across YouTube and TikTok. Farbod is a serial entrepreneur with one exit and is obsessed about distributing the highest quality content for their users. He’s spent months living with creators (literally) to understand their workflows, pain points, and what they need next. Values Mission over team over self :

* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:
* Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades:
Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em Neurologia, ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Neurologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios neurológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de:
conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Neurologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais neurológicos através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças neurológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Neurologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
